description: MDB: ADO CREATE PROCEDURE P1 (plain SELECT), P2 (parameterized UPDATE), P3 (parameterized SELECT), EXEC P1, EXEC P2 1, 'updated', EXEC P3 20, DAO QueryDefs+Parameters inspection, then DROP PROCEDURE P1/P2/P3. Keeps ALL pages (MSysObjects/MSysQueries/LvProp/page 0) before/after every statement and Close.

question.description: MDB: ADO CREATE PROCEDURE P1 (plain SELECT), P2 (parameterized UPDATE), P3 (parameterized SELECT), EXEC P1, EXEC P2 1, 'updated', EXEC P3 20, DAO QueryDefs+Parameters inspection, then DROP PROCEDURE P1/P2/P3. Keeps ALL pages (MSysObjects/MSysQueries/LvProp/page 0) before/after every statement and Close.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, V LONG, A TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO T (ID, V, A) VALUES (1, 10, 'a1')
INSERT INTO T (ID, V, A) VALUES (2, 20, 'a2')
INSERT INTO T (ID, V, A) VALUES (3, 30, 'a3')
CREATE PROCEDURE P1 AS SELECT ID, V FROM T WHERE V > 10
CREATE PROCEDURE P2 (pId LONG, pTxt TEXT(20)) AS UPDATE T SET A = pTxt WHERE ID = pId
SELECT ID, V, A FROM T ORDER BY ID
CREATE PROCEDURE P3 (pMin LONG) AS SELECT ID, V FROM T WHERE V >= pMin ORDER BY ID
